{'translation': 'In the iPhone Pro lineup, you have to pick the largest model to enjoy the best camera features, and this pattern has been consistent across generations. So far, most reports have indicated that the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max should share the same camera specifications, but a source today has raised some doubts about this.'}

{'translation': 'They specifically pointed out that two new features originally expected to be available on both Pro models "may" become exclusive to the Pro Max...'}

{'translation': 'The iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max have completely identical camera specifications, with all three rear lenses equipped with 48-megapixel sensors. Apple states that the telephoto lens offers up to 8x optical zoom, but in reality this is achieved through a 24-megapixel crop, so a more accurate description would be 4x optical zoom, with an option for a cropped 8x image.'}

{'translation': "Previously, we had (mainly) expected this year's Pro models to maintain consistent camera specifications, with both devices featuring a variable aperture main lens and a telephoto lens with a larger aperture, the latter of which would improve low-light photography performance."}

{'translation': 'However, leaker Ice Universe says these two new telephoto lens features may be exclusive to the iPhone 18 Pro Max.'}

{'translation': 'If this information turns out to be true, it means you\'ll have to buy the Pro Max if you want the strongest telephoto shooting capability and the best low-light performance. However, the use of the word "may" shows that he is not very certain about this, possibly because he has seen conflicting evidence within Apple\'s supply chain.'}

{'translation': 'There have also been previous reports suggesting that the variable aperture system on the main lens might be exclusive to the Pro Max, but the relevant reports have been mixed.'}

{'translation': "If you've always preferred the smaller of the two Pro models, but know that the Pro Max has better camera features, would you upgrade to the Pro Max? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section."}
